name: usdt-p2p-palestine
description: USDT P2P Palestine — Cloudflare Workers + D1 + R2 + Pages

scripts.build: wrangler d1 migrations apply usdt-palestine-db --remote --name usdt-p2p-palestine && wrangler d1 execute usdt-palestine-db --remote --name usdt-p2p-palestine --command "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO platform_config (key, value) VALUES ('p2p_fee_percent', '1.0')" && wrangler d1 execute usdt-palestine-db --remote --name usdt-p2p-palestine --command "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO platform_config (key, value) VALUES ('cash_fee_percent', '1.0')" && wrangler d1 execute usdt-palestine-db --remote --name usdt-p2p-palestine --command "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO platform_config (key, value) VALUES ('min_fee', '0.1')" && wrangler d1 execute usdt-palestine-db --remote --name usdt-p2p-palestine --command "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO platform_config (key, value) VALUES ('max_fee', '100.0')" && wrangler d1 execute usdt-palestine-db --remote --name usdt-p2p-palestine --command "INSERT OR IGNORE INTO market_price (id, usd_ils, usdt_ils) VALUES (1, 3.7, 3.7)" && wrangler deploy --name usdt-p2p-palestine
